centos-5.name: CentOS 5.11 (netinstall from the vault)
centos-5.notes: CentOS 5.11 (September 2014, the last of the 5 series, kernel 2.6.18): the netinstall CD asks where the repository is: HTTP, server vault.centos.org, directory /5.11/os/x86_64/. The 5.x kernel drives the virtio disk and NIC (since 5.3). Manual for now: almalinux-server's kickstart flow is the road to unattended, the anaconda of that era takes ks= on the serial console.

centos-6.name: CentOS 6.10 (minimal)
centos-6.notes: CentOS 6.10 (July 2018, kernel 2.6.32, the last 6): the minimal ISO installs a base system from itself. Afterwards yum needs the vault: replace mirrorlist with baseurl=http://vault.centos.org/6.10/os/x86_64/ in CentOS-Base.repo (mirrorlist.centos.org is gone).

centos-7.name: CentOS 7.9.2009 (minimal)
centos-7.notes: CentOS 7.9.2009 (November 2020, kernel 3.10, end of life June 2024): the minimal ISO installs from itself; yum then needs baseurl=http://vault.centos.org/7.9.2009/os/x86_64/.

centos-8.name: CentOS Linux 8.5.2111 (boot ISO, vault repositories)
centos-8.notes: CentOS Linux 8.5.2111 (November 2021, the last CentOS Linux 8, end of life December 2021): the boot ISO carries no packages, so set the installation source to https://vault.centos.org/8.5.2111/BaseOS/x86_64/os/ and add AppStream as an additional repository. centos-stream-10 is the living branch.
